Thanks,
Marcus

Subject: Re: Proposed scope and control assumptions (Acme) — initial ask

Marcus — thanks for the context and the attachments. We reviewed the scope doc and here are the artifacts and clarifications we need to produce an evidence request aligned to ISO27001 + FedRAMP (moderate):

1) Boundary documentation: final scope matrix (spreadsheet) with service/component mapping to control owners (owner email + team).
2) Network diagrams (layered): management, control plane, data plane (include peering and 3rd-party networking).
3) KMS and key lifecycle: KMS policy, rotation logs for last 90 days, HSM attestations if used.
4) Identity & Access: list of privileged roles, IAM policy snapshots, proof of MFA enforcement (logs or conditional access policies).
5) Logging & monitoring: retention policy, sample log extracts for 7/20 snapshot (redacted), alerting runbook examples.
6) Change control: recent change tickets (last 90 days) impacting infra in scope, CI/CD pipeline screenshots showing approval gates.
7) SOC2 Type II or bridge letter: if you have a recent report, provide redacted copy; otherwise we will ask for compensating evidence.
8) CAIQ / SIG-lite mapping: we will include a 60-question SIG-lite subset focused on cloud controls; please identify any third-party sub-processors used by the Private deployment.

We also attach our evidence_request_list.pdf with suggested templates. Two clarifying asks:
- Please confirm the exact AWS account IDs / project IDs that map to the Private deployment.
- Are there any cross-region replicas or DR artifacts we should include in scope?

If you can deliver the boundary spreadsheet and owner list by 7/14 EOD we will produce the formal intake checklist.

Best,
VendorSec Audit Team
